title: Partners of a Glorious Hope
description: Partners of a Glorious Hope in Tonic Solfa to ST. BEES, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in the supplement of the 1866 edition of A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1866), as hymn 561, “Communion Hymn”, where the book credits them to Wesleyan.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7) (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. BEES; any other Sevens (7.7.7.7) tune fits them as well.
underlay: Part-ners of a glo-rious hope, Lift your hearts and voi-ces up! No-bly let us bear the strife, Keep the ho-li-ness, of life;

lines: Lift your hearts and voices up!
Nobly let us bear the strife,
Follow Christ in heart and mind,
Jesus, fill us with thy love,
Heart to heart unite and bless,
Keep us in thy perfect peace!
In our lives our faith be known,
Faith that always works by love.

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1866.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1866); set to ST. BEES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
